name: EM-Cube Architecture
definition: A VLSI architecture for low-cost, high quality volume rendering at full video frame rates. It computes sample points and gradients on-the-fly to project 3-dimensional volume data onto 2-dimensional images with realistic lighting and shading.
summary: EM-Cube is a VLSI architecture for low-cost, high-quality volume rendering that uses block-skewed memory and sectioning to exploit SDRAM bandwidth while reducing on-chip storage.
